verdict.rationale: Jan documents downloading and running multiple LLM families (Llama, Gemma, Qwen, GPT-oss) from Hugging Face by model ID and importing arbitrary GGUF files, powered by llama.cpp. That gives broad LLM coverage, but the evidence names no other architecture classes and makes no 'hundreds of architectures' claim. missing for 10: explicit MoE support, multi-modal/vision model support, embedding model support, a documented list or breadth of supported architectures, independent hands-on corroboration.
